descriptionHtml:
The IEEE Communications Society Student Branch Chapter of the University of Peradeniya successfully organized a technical session titled “6G Meets AI: Future of Mobile Intelligence”, featuring Prof. Arumugam Nallanathan from Queen Mary University of London.

Held on 14 July 2025 at the Smart Study Area, the session provided valuable insights into the convergence of 6G wireless technologies and Large AI Models. The discussion explored future mobile intelligence, emerging research directions, and real-world challenges, fostering active engagement among students and academic staff.

The event enhanced participants’ understanding of next-generation wireless communication systems and their integration with artificial intelligence.
